title: Conan's Christmas Case
logline: A special episode of Detective Conan featuring a series of holiday-themed mysteries that test the limits of the detective's skill set.
synopsis: During the holiday season, a series of strange incidents occur around Tokyo. Conan and his friends must work together to solve these mysterious cases while also enjoying the festive atmosphere.

acts.title: Act I: The Christmas Tree Mystery

scenes.panel1: A tree lot is robbed, leaving only presents behind.
scenes.panel2: Conan deduces the identity of the thief.

scenes.panel1: Conan and Ran visit a department store for Christmas shopping.

acts.title: Act II: The Santa Claus Imposter

scenes.panel1: A man dressed as Santa Claus is accused of a crime he didn't commit.

acts.title: Act III: The New Year's Eve Resolution

scenes.panel1: A wealthy businessman makes a mysterious New Year's resolution.
scenes.panel2: Conan investigates and uncovers a shocking secret.

visual_style: Combination of traditional manga art style and modern anime techniques.
color_palette: Warm holiday colors (red, green, gold), cool winter tones (blue, silver, white)
music_mood: A blend of suspenseful mystery music and festive holiday tunes
transmedia_notes: Potential for tie-in merchandise such as manga books, action figures, and apparel.
Cross promotion with Crunchyroll for streaming and presentation on their platform.
